# Tidepool Landing Page Build Plan

**Brand system:** Cream (#FAF7F2) base, deep ink (#12232E) text, teal (#0D7A73) accent, coral (#E8604C) sparingly for CTAs. Fraunces (serif) for headlines, Inter for body. Coastal-calm, anti-hype.

**1. Sticky Nav** — Logo (wave mark) left; Product, Pricing, Changelog center; "Start free" teal pill right.

**2. Hero** — Centered single column. Headline: "Plan the week together. Then get back to work." Subhead clarifies: shared Monday planning, Friday wrap, 15 minutes. Primary CTA "Start free," secondary "See a demo week." Below: tilted screenshot of the shared week board — teammate avatars, capacity bars, one task moved live.

**3. Proof strip** — Thin band, one stat only: "1,200 teams under 20 people plan here." No fake logo wall.

**4. Manifesto** — Sand-tinted band, oversized serif line: "Planning shouldn't be another meeting." Two sentences on spreadsheet chaos, no feature list.

**5. How it works** — Three numbered columns: Monday check-in, midweek adjustment, Friday wrap. Line-drawn icons (sunrise, wave, sunset). Copy uses verbs, not nouns: "Share what you're riding," "Rebalance when things shift."

**6. Feature bento** — Asymmetric 4-card grid, each with a mini live-UI mockup (never stock illustration): Shared week view; Workload balance (capacity shown as water levels); Async updates; Slack integration. Card copy: one benefit, one detail.

**7. Rhythm** — Dark ink section, animated tide graphic. Emotional beat: sustainable pace over hustle. Copy: "Your week has a rhythm. Work with it."

**8. Testimonial** — Single large quote, warm background, portrait photo, name, team size ("Maya, 8-person studio").

**9. Pricing line** — One sentence, no table: "Free up to 5 people. $4/person after."

**10. Final CTA + Footer** — Teal band. "Ride a calmer week." Email input + button. Minimal footer links, wave divider.

**Copy rules:** concrete verbs, short sentences, tide metaphors used twice maximum.
final:
# Tidepool Landing Page — Revised Build Plan

**Key changes:** cut the redundant "Rhythm" emotional section (two emotional peaks diluted each other), added an objection-handling comparison, made every claim numeric, upgraded the demo from static to interactive.

**Brand system:** Unchanged — cream (#FAF7F2), ink (#12232E), teal (#0D7A73), coral CTA. Fraunces headlines at extreme scale contrast against small Inter body. Add: 20px radii, generous 120px section padding.

**1. Nav** — Unchanged. Add "Watch a live week" anchor link.

**2. Hero** — Sharpened headline: "Plan the week together in 15 minutes." Sub carries specificity: "Tidepool replaces the Monday status meeting with a shared board — everyone logs focus and capacity before 9am, blockers surface themselves, Friday closes the loop." CTA secondary now opens an **editable sandbox board** seeded with fake teammates, not a screenshot. One annotation callout on the board: "Priya's load flags red → reassigned in two clicks."

**3. Proof strip** — "Built for teams of 3–20. 1,100 teams plan their Monday here." Scope qualifier adds honesty.

**4. Manifesto** — Kept but cut to two lines total: "Planning shouldn't be another meeting." + one sentence on spreadsheet sprawl.

**5. Comparison (new, replaces Rhythm)** — Dark ink band, two columns: *"Your Monday before"* (meeting wall, Kanban at 140%, blocker discovered Thursday) vs. *"with Tidepool"* (one board, balanced loads, blockers named Monday). Handles the "we already use Notion" objection concretely.

**6. How it works** — Three steps, sunrise/wave/sunset line icons. All verbs: "Share what you're riding," "Rebalance midweek," "Close the loop Friday."

**7. Feature bento** — Trimmed to 3 cards + thin Slack strip. Each mockup shows a *state change*, not a static UI: capacity rendered as water levels dropping from 120% to 95%.

**8. Testimonial** — Outcome-driven: "Our Monday sync went from 45 minutes to a thread. We got our mornings back." — Maya, ops lead, 8-person studio.

**9. Pricing** — One line + trust row: "Free to 5 people, $4/person after. No card, export anytime."

**10. Final CTA** — Now owns the emotional beat with animated tide line: "Ride a calmer week." Email capture. Footer with wave divider.

**Copy rules:** numbers over adjectives, tide metaphor twice maximum, never "supercharge" or "streamline."
